scope: mechanism audit of HMSA soft auxiliary supervision

data_access.historical_test_access: forbidden during all CBRD development and Stage 0

legacy_source_closure.required: all source-lock and formal-lock blobs must match SHA-256; materialize an immutable archive below thesis_exp/exp57_cbrd/legacy_source

mathematical_contract.residual_target: r = e_y - d; it is a signed gradient-routing term, not a probability distribution

stage0_gates.gradient_identity: ordinary HMSA and routed HMSA must agree for logits, auxiliary-head parameters, hidden states, and bottom/top backbone parameters under identical deterministic audit kernels; if the CUDA stack still has early-layer nondeterminism, routed-vs-ordinary may not exceed ordinary-vs-ordinary repeat noise
stage0_gates.route_directionality: on one frozen batch containing zero/down/up states, verify full=consensus+residual, flipped=consensus-residual, shuffled=consensus+shuffled-residual, unanimous residual=0, and identical hard/soft head gradients across all soft-target routing controls
stage0_gates.data_support: all train/dev rows must be either unanimous or adjacent 2:1 and the empirical mean must equal the stored human mean
stage0_gates.shuffle: reproduce Exp55 seed 20260730 mapping SHA b4e96c49607700be99816582c1b85a8085b8c5abb260ddafbad4e9ee0dc25ad4 and its 1490/2654 effective target changes

main_confirmatory_comparison: Routed-HMSA versus CBRD-Consensus-only, with an identical original empirical soft target on the auxiliary head and only the backbone residual route differing
implementation_constraints: Use one original soft-CE forward/backward so the auxiliary-head target, scalar loss, and parameter gradient are identical across all residual-routing controls.
Route only the auxiliary hidden branch's gradient to the shared backbone; the hard path remains untouched.
Routed-HMSA uses an identity hook and must match ordinary HMSA in FP32 and BF16.

Consensus-only subtracts the analytic residual hidden gradient once; Residual-only replaces the auxiliary hidden gradient; Sign-flipped subtracts it twice; Shuffled-residual replaces only the aligned residual component.
Accumulate the hard and auxiliary branches, unscale once if AMP is used, clip the whole model once, then optimizer-step once.
The hard head alone is used for inference and checkpoint selection.
